text:
Same street, two ramen legends. 🍜

One opened as a street stall in 1938.
The other in 1947.
They sit side by side,
five minutes from Kyoto Station.

Daiichi Asahi opens at 6:00.
It serves until 1:00 at night.

Have you queued for either of them?

#Kyoto #KyotoStation #KyotoRamen #JapanFood #JapanTravel
